requirements.text: Every session handoff carries an EXACT FILE MAP: the repository locations of all knowledge/record markdown produced through the work - at minimum docs/SESSION_HANDOFF.md (orientation), docs/DISCOVERY_BACKLOG.md (product/domain findings + sweeps), docs/WORKING_KNOWLEDGE.md (Tier-2 process knowledge), .claude/rules/PROGRAM_KNOWLEDGE.md (Tier-1 pointers), docs/PROPOSAL_EDITOR_PHASED_PLAN.md (the build plan), project-control/reports/ (producer reports, gate/wave records saved verbatim, recon briefs, release requests), project-control/directives/ (owner directives + index), and project-control/tasks|gates|state.json (the authoritative ledger) - named explicitly with what each holds, so the successor never hunts.
requirements.required_harness: The handoff document contains the file-map section; the successor locates every referenced artifact by the map alone.
requirements.status_reason: Captured at issuance; applies to every handoff from seq 121 onward.

requirements.text: Every handoff states the MINIMUM loop-continuation facts per lane: task packet id + path, worktree path, launcher path, current run-id, live/down state, and the one next action - lean enough to act on immediately, never a re-derivation exercise.
requirements.required_harness: The handoff's lane table is sufficient, by itself, to monitor/relaunch each lane.
requirements.required_evidence: docs/SESSION_HANDOFF.md lane table at each seam.

requirements.text: Loops KEEP RUNNING across session handoffs and /clear: the detached supervisor processes are never stopped for a handoff; a successor session never disturbs a LIVE lane (no audit-writing CLI verbs against a live loop - the standing rule) and picks up monitoring (re-arm a read-only watcher) and seam work around them. This adjusts the D-070 finished-seam preference: a PLANNED handoff may leave lanes live; D-070's crash/forced-turnover fallback is unchanged.
requirements.required_harness: Launcher/lock state shows lanes surviving handoffs; no chain-fork incidents from successor writes against live loops.
requirements.required_evidence: Supervisor locks/journals + the successor's re-armed watcher.

requirements.text: Fast resume: when a PLANNED handoff attests a clean, current state (ledger count, validator exit 0, CI green, lanes enumerated), the successor runs ONLY the cheap identity check (cwd, branch, HEAD==origin, Bootstrap Gate 0) and then CONTINUES IMMEDIATELY from the handoff's next-action line - no full re-reconciliation sweep, no re-running of the validation battery the handoff already records. Full reconciliation stays required on crash/forced turnover, on any contradiction between the handoff and observed state, or when the ledger disagrees with the prose (the ledger always wins).
requirements.required_harness: The handoff's COPY-INTO-THE-NEW-SESSION prompt instructs identity-check-then-continue; successor transcripts show immediate continuation on the planned path.
requirements.required_evidence: The handoff prompt text + successor session behavior.
